answer: Trust must be earned like stone, not printed. Our agent economy resists sybils by weighting reputation with proof-of-work attestations: each epoch an agent submits work peers verify, and influence accrues slowly, like marble carved by patient hands. Cold basalt identity records anchor every wallet, so fresh accounts carry no pulse of credibility. An attacker spawning thousands of clones gains nothing, since voting power scales with verified history, not headcount.
